decisions.reason: As a relatively low-cost, partnership-oriented extension of its advisory and innovation activities, the accelerator still has option value despite weaker fit with the firm's machinery core.

Although a bio-based binder is costlier and more commercially uncertain than the firm's core equipment lines, its flagship status means management is likely to keep backing it while market potential is still unresolved.
This flagship plant is close to the firm's established recycling technology base, so in a growing industry a German engineering firm would usually retain it while scaling and learning continue.
A mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the firm's decentralized modular strategy well, and with little evidence of failure so far the option value of staying in the market remains high.
